If Thou be the Son of God

Richard Crashaw (B.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘If thou be the Son of God cast Thyself down.’—M
ATT.
 
IV.
 6
.
C
AST
 Thyself from the pinnacle whereon
I set Thee, or I think Thee not God’s Son.
No; but He’ll cast Thee from the hearts of men,
Satan. Wilt believe He’s God’s son then?
